To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We have computed the NNLO corrections to the gluon fusion Higg production cross-section for a model in which the Higgs bosons couplings to quarks are top-like.

the gluon fusion Higg production cross section is enhanced by a large amount at NLO in an extension of the SM with four generations, and that the relative magnitude and sign of the higher-order corrections is similar to the SM.

we have computed the next-to-next-to-leading order QCD corrections to the gluon fusion Higss production cross-section in an effective theory that includes a heavy quark with mass m and coupling to the Higgs via a Yukawa interaction with a coefficient y.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the calculation of the NNLO gluon-fusion cross section for a Higgs particle in extensions of the Standard model with a number of heavy quarks, and with the application of this result to an exclusion analysis of a fourth generation of quarks at the Tevatton.
the calculation of the gluon fusion Higg production cross-section in the Standard Model and its extensions with many heavy quark generations.
a study of the gluon fusion production of a Higgs bosons in a model with four heavy quarks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Standard Model is excluded for mH < 140 GeV at 95% CL.
the NNLO corrections to the gluon fusion production of a Higgs bosons in a four generation model are similar to those in the SM.
the Standard Model analysis can be applied to this model with a precision of about 10%.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we can compute the NNLO cross-section for gluon fusion Higg production in a model-independent way, which is a useful tool to carry out exclusion analyses in extensions of the Standard model with heavy quarks.
the gluon fusion process in a four-generation Standard model has been studied in a fully consistent manner at the next-to-next-to-leading order in QCD.
the gluon fusion Higg production cross-section in the presence of heavy top-like quarks can be computed with the same accuracy and the same level of reliability as the Standard Model case.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NNLO corrections are not large enough to change the conclusions of a LO analysis, but are necessary to carry out an accurate analysis of the data.
a Higgs bosons mass of 160 GeV or larger is excluded by Tevatron data in this model.
the Higgs mass can be constrained with high precision even if the Higgs bosons is lighter than twice any heavy quark mass.
